description: An online shop, up to the first checkout screen.

journey.audience: <who is buying, and what they came for>
journey.endsAt: The first checkout screen. Nothing is added, submitted or bought; the read-only guard blocks requests that change anything, so a step that needs one stops there and is recorded as Stopped at submit.

stages.name: Arrive and orient
stages.task: You're looking for this kind of product and arrive from a search. What do you do first?
checks: The first screen says what the shop sells, in plain words
One primary route (shop, search) stands out

stages.name: Find the product
stages.task: You want a specific product. How do you find it?
checks: Category labels use shoppers' own words
Filters match what shoppers compare on

stages.name: Decide
stages.task: You're on the product page. Find the price, delivery and returns.
checks: The full price is visible near the main action
Delivery cost and time are visible before the basket
Returns are explained or one click away

stages.name: Start checkout
stages.task: You want to buy it. Where do you click?
checks: The main action is clear and labelled with the outcome
Guest checkout is offered, or why an account is needed
The first checkout screen asks only for essentials

stages.name: Reassurance
stages.task: Before paying, you want to know you can trust this shop. Where do you look?
checks: Who runs the shop and where is stated
Help or contact is visible during checkout
